en: Soldier. Head brownish yellow, short cylindrical, the sides flaring slightly backwards and the hind margin broadly rounded. In profile the frontal dorsal corners are weakly raised, the declivity about forty-five degrees, and the dorsal margin of the head gently convex. The frons shows a shallow V-shaped depression; the anterior arms of the coronal suture and both ocellus and compound eye are discernible. Labrum trapezoidal with an upturned, strongly curved apex; the mandibular basal tubercle is prominent and the left mandible reaches about half the head length. Antennae ten segmented. Postmentum five times as long as its narrowest breadth, broadest just behind the anterior third. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, with shallow emarginations.
soldier: 兵蚁头壳褐中带黄，上颚深褐，上唇与触角黄褐，前胸背板、腹部及足淡黄。头壳短圆柱形，两侧稍向后张开，后缘宽圆；侧面观额背角略隆，额坡约四十五度，头背缘微微拱起，后颏底缘平直。额面呈V形浅凹，Y形缝前臂可见，单眼与复眼均能辨出。上唇梯形，端部向上翘起且较弯，颚基峰突出，左上颚长约合头壳之半。触角十节。后颏长度为最狭处的五倍，最宽区位于前面三分之一之后，该区中央有一淡色点状隆起，腰区落在后面三分之一。前胸背板略窄于头壳，前缘浅凹，两侧平行，后缘近直，前、后缘中央的缺切都很浅。
